title: AION 2 Builds: Starter Skills and Stigmas
description: Find sourced AION 2 Chanter, Cleric, and Assassin starting examples and learn how region, Stigmas, Daevanion, skill options, and combos fit together.
summary: Choose a build for your region, level, and job. Use sourced starting examples, check unlocked options, and improve the part that causes problems in real encounters.
quickAnswer: For party PvE, start with the Cleric recovery setup or Chanter mantra setup below, then select the skill options and equip the Stigmas your character has unlocked. Match the example’s region, progression and party role before copying its rotation.

topic.alt: Official Chanter artwork illustrating one of the AION 2 starting builds
topic.caption: Official Chanter class artwork, one of the three starter examples below. The image is not a skill allocation or an equipped-build screenshot.

workflow.title: Copy a build without copying unavailable options
workflow.caption: Work through these checks in order; a matching class name alone does not reproduce a later character's setup.

steps.label: Match the context
steps.description: Record region, level, activity, and whether your party supplies healing or overlapping buffs.

steps.label: Select actual skill options
steps.description: Spend within your budget, then explicitly choose the unlocked specialization used by the example.

steps.label: Equip the role tools
steps.description: Fill only visible Stigma slots and keep the recovery or defensive tool your job requires.

steps.label: Prove the interaction
steps.description: Manually test the expected trigger or reset before adding a repeating attack sequence.

steps.label: Save and change one part
steps.description: Record selected options and retest one failed interaction or missing party function at a time.
